newsitem.title: USA: Atlas no longer Vista holder.
newsitem.headline: Atlas no longer Vista holder.

text.p: Vista Gold Corp said Monday that Atlas Corp is no longer a major shareholder of the company.
Last week Atlas announced that it had exchanged 8,313,076 common shares of Vista Gold with holders of the outstanding exchangeable debentures of Atlas.
Vista Gold said Monday that those shares were the remainder of the stock owned by Atlas and were held by a trustee as security for the Atlas debentures.
It said the move means its publicly held float should increase to over 80 million shares, representing 90 percent of the 89 million shares outstanding.
"Now that these shares are no longer restricted, we expect even greater liquidity in our stock," Vista Gold said in a statement Monday.
Vista Gold is an international gold mining, development and exploration company based in Denver, Colorado, with its registered office in Vancouver, British Columbia.
